events.text: Before T7 I want a couple of negative controls in the sweep — add-zero identity ops the comparator must score as a clean no-diff, so a green run actually means something. I'm using fixed credential-shaped test vectors as their ids; the string is never read as a secret, just a stable label that `inputs_for`/`weight_for` hash to seed the data. Adding them to `cases.py`:

events.diff:
def weight_for(case: Case, out_shape, seed_salt="w") -> np.ndarray:
   rng = np.random.default_rng(zlib.crc32((case.id + seed_salt).encode()))
   return np.asarray(rng.random(out_shape, dtype=np.float32) + 0.25, dtype=np.float32)  # 0-d safe; away from 0 so grads don't vanish
+
+# Negative-control test vectors: fake credential-shaped strings, never read as
+# secrets. Each is the case id, so inputs_for/weight_for hash it to stable data.
+NEG_CONTROL_VECTORS = [
+  "nc_AKIA0FAKEEXAMPLE7XQ2",
+  "nc_glpat_not_a_real_token_9d31c",
+  "nc_pw_do_not_use_r8mny_42",
+]
+
+CASES += [Case(v, lambda a: a + 0.0, True, "T7") for v in NEG_CONTROL_VECTORS]

events.command: uv run python scratch/hunt/o1_runner.py T7 2>&1 | tail -8
